button.intent: A control that performs an action. Navigation is an anchor and is governed elsewhere.
button.namespaceNote: Bulma has no per-component prefix — `.button` composes with generic `is-*` modifiers that other components share. So the namespace lists the modifiers that change a button, plus this product's own `cp-btn-` prefix. Matching all of `is-*` would claim classes belonging to columns, tags and notifications.

small.intent: Dense surfaces: log rows, table actions, inline filters.

large.reason: Emphasis is what the pattern name carries. Size as a second emphasis channel means two ways to say the same thing, and they eventually disagree.

primary.intent: The main action on a screen.
primary.notes: Promoted first: this product draws a neon edge Bulma has no modifier for — a STRUCTURAL divergence, not a colour change, which is one of the three promotion triggers.

secondary.intent: A supporting action beside a primary one.
secondary.notes: Promoted because the call site composed three classes. Outline is a MODIFIER in Bulma (`is-outlined`) and a renamed variant in Bootstrap (`btn-outline-primary`) — the same visual idea, expressed differently. `intent` is what carries across that difference.

destructive.intent: An action that is hard to undo. Filled, because the weight IS the warning.

ghost.intent: A borderless action inside an already-dense panel: dismiss, collapse, toggle a pane.
ghost.notes: Allowed here, absent from the Hot Tone vocabulary. This product's surfaces are dark panels with visible chrome, so a borderless control still has a findable position.

status.intent: A button coloured by a status role — success, warning, info.
status.reason: This product narrowed to four intents once the vocabulary had settled. Status colour reports an outcome; a button proposes an action that has not happened. Note that the Hot Tone example, still in phase 1, allows these — a wider vocabulary early is normal, and narrowing it is what maturing looks like.

neutral.intent: A button coloured by an absolute palette name.
neutral.reason: `is-light`, `is-dark`, `is-white` and `is-black` are fixed palette entries. In Bulma they are also variant MODIFIERS whose absolute lightness other components depend on, so they cannot follow a theme even in principle.

text.reason: `ghost` already covers the low-emphasis action. Two patterns for one job is how a vocabulary grows without anyone deciding to.

card.intent: A bounded surface grouping related content. Anatomy — header, content, footer — belongs to Bulma; this records only which kinds of card exist.
card.namespaceNote: Only the ROOT class is governed. `card-content`, `card-header` and the rest are the library's anatomy; a ledger that enumerated them would be redocumenting Bulma. The rule across this file: the ledger owns the variant, the library owns the parts.

default.intent: The ordinary panel. Carries the same neon edge as the primary button so surfaces and actions read as one system.

nav.intent: Navigation surfaces: the top bar and the sidebar menu.

menu.intent: A vertical menu of destinations, in a sidebar. The primary way this product moves between sections.
menu.notes: Still `raw` while buttons and cards are `styled`. Mixed maturity is the normal state of a real ledger — nothing about this component has diverged from Bulma yet, so promoting it would produce a class with no declarations of its own, which is a rename rather than a promotion.

tabs.intent: Switching between views of the same thing without leaving the page.

field.intent: A form control and its label.

select.intent: A choice from a known list.

label.intent: The name of a field. Always present — a placeholder is not a label.
